planned_arguments.prompt:
Create one finished, single flat opaque 16:9 landscape editorial poster for a weekend houseplant market, for SNS. The substantive photographic comparison is the visual idea: choosing a plant at a scale that fits daily life, and enjoying living with it.

Input image 1 is a newly authored planning diagram for copy clearance, Korean letter anatomy, two unequal photographic distances and the prose-to-visit reading relationship. It is not final artwork, not a pale-gray style reference, and not fixed coordinates. Translate the neutral shapes into the real photographic scenes below. Keep the legibility and meaningful groups; do not reproduce the blob leaves, gray placeholders or diagram hand. Do not print internal labels.

Whole design: two decisively edited, natural-color photographs with unequal widths and heights. On the upper left, a broad close photograph, shot at waist height, shows a real person's forearm entering from the left and an anatomically believable palm supporting the base of a modest plain nursery pot. Show the pot rim, soil, attached stems and fresh small peperomia leaves in believable scale to the hand. Crop the person at the forearm rather than showing a face. There is an unmistakable pot-to-palm contact and one continuous limb; do not hide the support with blur. Let the near photograph extend broadly across the left portion. On the right, a taller narrower photograph starts near the top and extends down to the lower reading ledge. It shows a larger leafy rubber tree in an unembellished warm-gray ceramic pot beside the decisively cropped edge of an ordinary wooden domestic chair. Show the chair seat and legs, floor, full pot base and plant stems attached to the soil. This view establishes lived scale, with the plant occupying substantial space rather than an empty room reserved for type. The two plants are different specimens, not a before/after transformation. Use coherent natural daylight, deep living greens, controlled highlight exposure, neutral skin, realistic pottery and crisp botanical structures. Rectangular picture edges are exact and clean.

The modest Korean title sits at the upper-left photographic start above the broad near photo. Its smaller Latin companion is directly underneath. Use mature Korean serif forms for the title: open counters, restrained stroke contrast, clear syllable construction and intact word spaces, optically quieter than the combined photography. The Latin companion is a smaller, steady sans. Immediately below the near-photo edge, the visible slogan leads to the complete broad three-line paragraph. Keep the three meaningful lines shown below together, left-aligned with ordinary leading. Make the paragraph an ample editorial reading body, not a caption. Use medium-weight Korean sans forms with balanced rectangular syllables, stable consonant/vowel proportions, flat clean strokes and generous counters. Match numeral/Latin optical weight to Hangul. In a 720-pixel-wide viewing assumption the prose and practical details should be comfortably readable, approximately the apparent body scale of the supplied guide. Do not shrink them to fit.

The paragraph ends on the same left start that begins the market-name group below, with one local vertical gap. Give the whole lower region real reading space: market name followed by date; hours and venue share a nearby baseline. An adjoining equally readable group begins beside the market name and contains access, care, then invitation and URL immediately beneath. The two lower groups are connected across a common ledge created by the photographic edit. Keep clear grouping and practical proximity, not dispersed corner captions or a tiny footer. Quiet charcoal planar print on a warm neutral editorial ground; photography has natural surfaces and deep greens, without decorative texture or tape.

Only the following supplied copy is printed, each entry exactly once, with exact Korean, Latin capitalization, numbers, meaningful word spaces and punctuation. The paragraph's line breaks are soft layout choices; preserve all wording. Preserve en dashes distinctly from hyphens, colons, middle dots, ampersand, periods and the unbroken URL. The headings in this prompt are instructions and are not printed.

재배자의 이야기를 듣고,
우리 집의 빛과 생활에 맞는 식물을 골라보세요.

Finish the entire designed poster in this one native image, with opaque background. No extra copy, labels, printed plant tags, logo, QR, watermark or photographic image lettering. No mockup, room display, comparison sheet, multiple poster variants or surrounding presentation. This one poster legitimately contains the two content-based photographic views. Exclude passive solid/near-solid/split-color gothic headline/date/information templates with subordinate tiny imagery, texture/font substitutions or empty-room dressing; the photographic distances, crops and ledge must organize the whole image/text relationship. Exclude clay/toy/complementary packages and big-object/big-title/tiny-footer packaging. Quiet space and precise sans body text remain appropriate within this photographic editorial system.
